thread:
Mariela (sales): Quick sync — Pilot with AdopterCo starts tomorrow. They hit a couple integration gotchas during the dry run, can presales/eng advise?
Tom R (presales): Saw the logs. Main issues: heartbeat disconnects on long-running SSE sessions, structured JSON schema mismatch for tool calls, and SSO token refresh errors.
Priya N (eng): Heard. Heartbeat: by default our SDK sends keepalive every 25s; their proxy drops idle after 30s during heavy payloads. Recommend 10s heartbeats + smaller chunking.
Mariela (sales): Can we ship a config patch or is it client-side only?
Priya N (eng): Quick fix = client-side: set `SDK_KEEPALIVE=10s` or call `client.setHeartbeat(10000)`. We can add a snippet to the sample app ASAP.
Tom R (presales): They also saw `func_call` responses with keys in snake_case while their deserializer expects camelCase. It's breaking our validation.
Priya N (eng): For structured tool outputs we support both styles but the sample tool schema in the repo uses camelCase. Likely their adapter is inserting snake_case. We can add a small transformer: `normalizeKeys(response, 'camel')` in the example.
Mariela (sales): Good. What about the SSO refresh? They use SAML + short-lived creds in the edge connector.
Tom R (presales): The connector tries to refresh using the client credentials flow but their IdP requires a signed assertion. Error is: `invalid_grant: missing_assertion`.
Priya N (eng): Two options: (1) Use the session exchange endpoint on our side (we support signed assertions) — requires entitlements on the pilot contract; OR (2) they can pre-provision a long-lived delegated key for the connector (security team ok with that for pilots).
Mariela (sales): Security will push back on long-lived keys. How fast can option (1) be enabled?
Priya N (eng): We can enable session exchange for the org within 24-48 hours if legal signs the pilot AUP. Need a short JIRA: `pilot-ADP-session-exchange`.
Mariela (sales): I'll file the JIRA and loop legal. Any enterprise blockers left (SOC2, KMS, IP allowlist)?
Tom R (presales): They asked about KMS integration for on-prem keys and IP allowlist for the connector egress. Also SOC2 attestation for Dedicated offers.
Priya N (eng): KMS: we support customer-managed keys via our Private tier; for pilots we can do a sealed-envelope workflow (we'll hold a wrapped key). IP allowlist: we can provide static egress IPs for Dedicated; for Hosted pilot we can use a proxy tunnel from their VPC. SOC2: we can share our attestation artifact but Dedicated + Private needed for formal compliance commitments.
Mariela (sales): Pricing question came up: they want to understand delta for streaming vs non-streaming token billing and cost when using function/tool calls.
Tom R (presales): Short answer: streaming is billed per token emitted same as non-streaming; function/tool calls add small fixed per-call metadata cost (see pricing appendix). For the pilot we can offer a capped pilot budget and log-level cost telemetry.
Priya N (eng): Also recommend `batching: disabled` for the demo to keep latency consistent. But for production we'll show them batching gains (up to 3-4x token efficiency on chat workloads).
infra-bot: Deploy failed for `pilot-sampleapp` during the dry run, error: `EADDRINUSE` on 8080 — ephemeral port clash.
Priya N (eng): That's minor — we should change sample app default to 0 (ephemeral) or select 8081 for the demo. I'll push PR with both heartbeat/samplefix and schema transformer.
Tom R (presales): Action items: 1) sales files JIRA for session exchange + legal AUP; 2) eng pushes sample app PR with heartbeat and key-normalizer; 3) sales to confirm pilot budget cap and KMS approach; 4) infra to redeploy sample app on new port.
Mariela (sales): I'll kick off JIRA now and DM legal + security. Ping me on Slack when PR is up so I can forward to the customer's SRE.
Priya N (eng): PR reference: draft `pr/834-pilot-heartbeat-schema` — will ping when ready.
Mariela (sales): Thanks team :thumbsup:
Tom R (presales): I'll update the runbook with `client.setHeartbeat(10000)`, `normalizeKeys(...)`, and the SSO options. Will also add a troubleshooting checklist for `EADDRINUSE`.
Mariela (sales): Excellent. If any blocker slips into tomorrow's live run we do a rollback to the previous sample image and fallback to non-streaming calls for the demo.
Priya N (eng): Agreed. I'll standby during the run.
Mariela (sales): End of thread — will update after legal JIRA and PR merge.
